parts.name: Select
parts.description: A labelled Radix select with owned trigger content. Native trigger attributes and ref apply to its button; asChild and custom children are not supported. Selection changes use onValueChange.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label and accessible name.

props.name: hint
props.description: Supporting field guidance, associated with the control.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Replaces hint text and marks the field invalid.

props.name: options
props.description: Ordered options with unique non-empty values, labels and optional disabled states.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size: small, medium or large.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Bordered field treatment or borderless text trigger.

props.name: font
props.description: Font role shared by the trigger and portalled options.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Visually hide the label while preserving its accessible association.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected option value; an empty string clears selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected option value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the selected option value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when the control has no value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: required
props.description: Require a selection for the owning native form.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the hidden native form control used to submit the selection.

props.name: form
props.description: ID of the form receiving the hidden native selection control.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Native key handler. Prevent default to skip built-in keyboard behavior.

props.name: onPointerDown
props.description: Native pointer-down handler. Prevent default to skip built-in pointer behavior.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Marks the native control invalid for assistive technology.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: IDs of additional descriptive elements; field components merge these with their hint or error ID.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: Native control ID. Generated when omitted; the visible label and supporting text use this association.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
